canonical_units.label: ИТАК vs И ТАК
canonical_units.decision_model: ИТАК is written solid when it marks a conclusion or transition; И ТАК is written separately when И and ТАК retain their own function, including the meaning 'и без того'.
canonical_units.classification_note: Authoritative references are not terminologically uniform about the grammatical label of ИТАК. The learner unit therefore tests the spelling/function contrast and punctuation in context, not a fabricated universal part-of-speech label.
